title: Related-list phone card: let an object say which fields fill the card subtitle (with labels or a format) and an optional title prefix, without changing the wide table
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAk8tegvAi1ECkgCFfc

Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed) · Source: maintainer — Irene chose to file this platform card on the hotcrm project thread's decision card (2026-11-27T09:00Z), approving the order-line card design in hotcrm#2828. · Type: Feature · Grade: left to objectstack triage.

## Need

HotCRM wants an order line's phone card to read:
- title: **"1. Implementation Services"**, with the line number as a small prefix;
- subtitle: **"Qty 1 × Unit Price ¥2,000.00 · Discount 10%"**, where the discount part appears only when there is one;
- amount: the line total, bottom right (see the companion defect card).

## What 18.6.0 allows (measured on HotCRM 08a7451e, 390 px)

- The card subtitle is the first two non-title, non-amount cells of the related list's table column order, joined with " · ", unlabelled (`ObjectGrid.tsx` `subtitleColumns = bodyColumns.filter(…).slice(0, 2)`). Today an order line reads "2 · 2", meaning line number · quantity.
- There is no card-layout setting for a related list: no card fields, amount field, subtitle format or title prefix. So the card cannot change without reordering the wide table, which the maintainer requires to stay unchanged.
- An app-side text formula "summary" field is not a fix. It adds a table column, carries one language while apps ship several locale packs, and cannot follow the tenant currency.

## Ask

A declarative card layout for a related list or object, for example in the object's `relatedListColumns` sibling or the list view, naming:
- the subtitle fields, rendered with their field labels or by a small format template that uses localized labels and currency formatting, with empty parts dropped;
- an optional title prefix field.
The wide table keeps its own columns. The spec contract and a generic renderer change belong to the platform; HotCRM would only declare the layout.

Who benefits: every app with line items or child lists on phones; the reader can check quantity × price = amount at a glance.

Dedupe: searched `card subtitle related list`, `related list card labels`, `phone card layout` (open and closed), 0 open hits. #28484 (closed) defined the one-line subtitle. #37008 (closed) added labels in the gallery path only.
